Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Ultron, who has gained the power of the Infinity Stones, and the new king Thanos
have returned to MARVEL Future Fight with even stronger powers!

 

In this additional patch, new Uniforms will be added for Infinity Ultron and Thanos,
and Ultron has become more powerful through Tier-3 Advancement.

 

Check out the new looks of Ultron and Thanos by downloading the 3/1 patch.

 

■  3/1 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 3/2 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 3/1 (Tue) 19:00 (PST)

* The patch completion time may change depending on the circumstances 

and the completion time will be updated once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

[ 3/2 (Wed) 3:13 (UTC+0), 3/1 (Tue) 19:13 (PST) added]

The patch has been completed as of 3/2 (Wed) 3:09 (UTC+0), 3/1 (Tue) 19:09 (PST). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

▣ Two New Uniforms


Check out the abilities of the two new Uniforms:
Infinity Ultron <Marvel Studios’ What If...?> with the power of the infinity stones,
and Thanos <Obsidian King> who has stood up as the king after conquering the universe.

 

 

 

* The new uniforms can be purchased after the 3/1 patch data is applied and will be on sale for 40% off.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* Skills are based on the maximum stats.

 

▣ Ultron Tier-3

 

Ultron is now available for Tier-3 Advancement!
Face the rage of the ultimate A.I. who has gained new powers!


 

 

▣ New Artifact

 

A new Artifact has been added for Thanos.

 

 

* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill LV.4 stats.

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

A new Uniform Collection has been added for the Infinity Watch themed Uniforms.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The issue of the skill “Phoenix Dash”  of Echo <Enter the Phoenix> not being activated and only the cooltime being applied when used at the maximum distance has been fixed.

 

2. The issue of the increase lightning damage effect of the passive skill “Unstable Current” of Electro <Modern> not being applied to allies properly has been fixed.

 

3. The issue of Spider-Man <Spider-Man: No Way Home (Integrated Suit)> and Spider-Man <Spider-Man: No Way Home (Black & Gold Suit)> only using the “Electric Manhole” skill when set as an ally hero in World Boss has been fixed.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events
that will be held in celebration of the new Uniforms for Thanos and Infinity Ultron.

 

Thank you.
